_about: Free for All on its own projects, without ammo crates (the owner, 2026-11-12/13: "there should just be no ammo crates", "TDM is good, nothing should change about it"): each Free for All config's map_name, its TDM map's project, becomes the map's own copy (<weather>_8, ffa-projects-1, as the FFA lists leave it), and every ammo crate of the copy is removed whole: its resupply_zone(s), decal(s) and collision_geometry (client_objects), its container_closed model(s) (render_visuals) and their collision_objects; the breakable lamps' visual indices after them follow. Team Deathmatch's projects keep their crates.
